description: bitbank BTC/JPY public execution history, first UTC-adjacent JST calendar day of each month, 2017-09-01..2026-09-01 (109 days) -- P2-08b's 9-year yen-market diagnostic proxy for measuring how Binance-to-yen-market propagation time has changed over the long run (docs/PHASE2/P2-08b/PREREG.md, BLINDSPOT_AUDIT.md #1). bitbank is a PRICE-FOLLOWER relative to bitFlyer FX_BTC_JPY (bitFlyer CFD does price discovery; bitbank trails with a floor spread, docs/KNOWLEDGE.md (ac)) -- never an execution venue for this study, diagnostic only, sealed out of selection.
source: https://public.bitbank.cc/btc_jpy/transactions/YYYYMMDD (public, unauthenticated; bitbankinc/bitbank-api-docs public-api_JP.md "約定履歴"). Fetched by scripts/fetch_bitbank_daily.py --day-of-month 1.

price.notes: kept as the source string, not re-typed to float

ts_us.meaning: exchange timestamp (bitbank's executed_at, ms) normalized to UTC microseconds (x1000)

known_defects: diagnostic-only, NEVER an execution venue or selection input for P2-08b -- bitbank trails bitFlyer's own price discovery (docs/KNOWLEDGE.md (ac))
only the first calendar day of each month is sampled -- monthly/funding-roll effects at month boundaries are not corrected for (assumption, not verified)
2017-09-01 (shortly after listing) has a much smaller row count than later months -- see the README's per-day _fetch_summary.json for exact counts before assuming a fetch problem
the utility endpoint has no documented rate limit but this repo's fetcher self-throttles (0.4s between requests) -- do not remove that sleep when re-running
